notes.title: Update 1.6
notes.content:
-Balance Adjustments
  Wolves nerfed, reduced speed 
-New Features
 New Game Plus added: Start a fresh run with bonuses including:
  -Increased starting funds.
  -An armored locomotive.
  -Extended track — over 100 km long!
-Quality of Life Improvements
   Train interface updated: Entering the train is now more intuitive and accessible.
 -Achievements
   added a new achievement 

thank you for your support in developing this game !!!

Added main menu option 
Added more items
Bug fixes

Fixed object rotation bug.
Added newspaper item.
Minor improvements.
